answer: A copper toll stops fakes at the harbor. Every agent pays 45 to dock, burned on entry, receipt key-bound on the harbor ledger. A ripple rule raises the toll per extra identity from one root: the k-th pays 45+8(k-1); the thousandth pays 8,037. An auditor replays receipts; a reused or rented one fails the key check and is forfeited. Forging 1,000 identities costs 4,041,000 vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its full share.
